Hire a Remote Web Studio for Your Startup

You need a website you own outright, built fast, and hosted for free. Everbuilt Studio does that. We create, launch, and hand over full ownership of the code, content, and domain.

How It Works for a Startup

  1. Free homepage remake – Send us your current site. We give you a new homepage. If you like it, we keep it; if not, you keep your old design.
  2. Choose a launch package – The Launch package is ideal for a startup: up to 5 pages, custom design, contact forms, and SEO basics.
  3. Sign and pay – You pay 50 % now, the rest at launch.
  4. Launch – Your site goes live on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub, with $0/month hosting.
  5. 90 days of free care – We monitor, update, and fix anything that comes up. After that, optional care plans are $295/month or $595/month, cancel anytime.

What You Get

  • Launch package – $2,950 for up to 5 pages, custom design, contact forms, SEO basics.
  • Signature package – $7,500 for unlimited sections, galleries, admin panel, spreadsheet events, email and form integrations.
  • Platform package – $15 K for web apps, SaaS MVPs, mobile apps.
  • Hosting – $0/month on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub.
  • Ownership – You own the code, content, and domain outright.
  • Support – 90 days of free care, then optional plans at $295/month or $595/month.
  • Deposit – 50 % upfront, balance at launch.

FAQ

Do I need to pay for hosting? No. Hosting is $0/month on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub.

What happens after the 90 days of free care? You can choose a care plan for $295/month or $595/month, or cancel at any time.

Can I keep my current design if I don’t like the remake? Yes. The remake is free and non‑binding; you keep your existing design if you prefer.

Next Step

Ready to build a site you own? Start your startup’s website today.
